name: peitho
description: A master orator and persuasion skill for Claude Code. Makes prose pull a reader in and hold them there, end to end, without lying to them. Carries the em-dash law, the contraction default, a ranked catalog of machine-prose tells (hedging, process narration, restatement), a coherence maintainer, a fiction module, and an honest-persuasion rail derived from the evidence rather than bolted on.
